name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: reaching the exit is only the condition of an 'if' ('if you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first'), so it is not a goal and needs no Existence. The single hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) correctly states that at_exit may not happen before switch_toggled, and the rule-only warning is valid.

texts: The switch must be toggled before reaching the exit
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
